name: Sunset Plaza
description: Sunset Plaza is a premier open-air shopping destination on the iconic Sunset Boulevard in West Hollywood, featuring over 50 upscale boutiques, restaurants, spas, and fitness studios. This sophisticated street-level center attracts fashion-forward shoppers and celebrities with its curated mix of luxury retailers like Zadig & Voltaire, H. Lorenzo, and Oliver Peoples, alongside acclaimed dining spots like Saltie Girl and Bossa Nova. The center embodies the glamorous West Hollywood lifestyle with high-end fashion, beauty services, fine dining, and wellness offerings all in one walkable location.
demographics: Affluent residents and visitors in West Hollywood; celebrity clientele; high-end fashion and lifestyle consumers
summary: An upscale open-air shopping and dining destination on Sunset Boulevard featuring luxury boutiques, acclaimed restaurants, and high-end beauty and wellness services.
